queries.name: VL info
queries.sql:
with attrs as (
  select a.lab_request_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'prereg-registration-time' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as prereg_registration_time,
    max(case when a.code = 'prereg-received-time' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as prereg_received_time,
    max(case when a.code = 'prereg-registration-facility' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as prereg_registration_facility,
    max(case when a.code = 'loinc-panel-code' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as loinc_panel_code,
    max(case when a.code = 'admit-attend-time' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as admit_attend_time,
    max(case when a.code = 'collection-volume' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as collection_volume,
    max(case when a.code = 'icd10-clinical-info' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as icd10_clinical_info,
    max(case when a.code = 'hl7-specimen-source' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as hl7_specimen_source,
    max(case when a.code = 'hl7-specimen-site' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as hl7_specimen_site,
    max(case when a.code = 'specimen-site-code' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as specimen_site_code,
    max(case when a.code = 'specimen-site-desc' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as specimen_site_desc,
    max(case when a.code = 'work-units' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as work_units,
    max(case when a.code = 'cost-units' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as cost_units,
    max(case when a.code = 'ordering-notes' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as ordering_notes,
    max(case when a.code = 'encrypted-patient-id' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as encrypted_patient_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'ethnic-group' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as ethnic_group,
    max(case when a.code = 'deceased' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as deceased,
    max(case when a.code = 'newborn' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as newborn,
    max(case when a.code = 'patient-class' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as patient_class,
    max(case when a.code = 'referring-request-id' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as referring_request_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'therapy' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as therapy,
    max(case when a.code = 'target-time-days' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as target_time_days,
    max(case when a.code = 'target-time-mins' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as target_time_mins,
    max(case when a.code = 'repeated' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as repeated
  from lab_request_attributes a
  where a.system = 'urn:openldr:cs:request-attribute'
  group by a.lab_request_id
)
select
  lr.request_id as "RequestID",
  lr.obr_set_id as "OBRSetID",
  lr.panel_code as "LIMSPanelCode",
  lr.panel_desc as "LIMSPanelDesc",
  lr.age_years as "AgeInYears",
  lr.age_days as "AgeInDays",
  p.sex as "HL7SexCode",
  ax.prereg_registration_time as "LIMSPreReg_RegistrationDateTime",
  ax.prereg_received_time as "LIMSPreReg_ReceivedDateTime",
  ax.prereg_registration_facility as "LIMSPreReg_RegistrationFacilityCode",
  dr.effective as "SpecimenDatetime",
  lr.authored_at as "RegisteredDateTime",
  s.received_time as "ReceivedDateTime",
  dr.issued as "AuthorisedDateTime",
  lr.analysis_at as "AnalysisDateTime",
  lr.rejection_code as "LIMSRejectionCode",
  lr.rejection_reason as "LIMSRejectionDesc",
  case when coalesce(preg.text_value, coalesce(preg.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || preg.numeric_value::text, preg.coded_value) is null then 'Unreported' else coalesce(preg.text_value, coalesce(preg.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || preg.numeric_value::text, preg.coded_value) end as "Pregnant",
  case when coalesce(bf.text_value, coalesce(bf.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || bf.numeric_value::text, bf.coded_value) is null then 'Unreported' else coalesce(bf.text_value, coalesce(bf.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || bf.numeric_value::text, bf.coded_value) end as "BreastFeeding",
  case when coalesce(ft.text_value, coalesce(ft.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || ft.numeric_value::text, ft.coded_value) is null then 'Unreported' else coalesce(ft.text_value, coalesce(ft.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || ft.numeric_value::text, ft.coded_value) end as "FirstTime",
  case when coalesce(cday.text_value, coalesce(cday.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || cday.numeric_value::text, cday.coded_value) is null then 'Unreported' else coalesce(cday.text_value, coalesce(cday.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || cday.numeric_value::text, cday.coded_value) end as "CollectedDate",
  coalesce(ctime.text_value, coalesce(ctime.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || ctime.numeric_value::text, ctime.coded_value) as "CollectedTime",
  coalesce(tarvd.text_value, coalesce(tarvd.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || tarvd.numeric_value::text, tarvd.coded_value) as "DataDeInicioDoTARV",
  coalesce(tarvp.text_value, coalesce(tarvp.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || tarvp.numeric_value::text, tarvp.coded_value) as "PrimeiraLinha",
  coalesce(tarvs.text_value, coalesce(tarvs.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || tarvs.numeric_value::text, tarvs.coded_value) as "SegundaLinha",
  coalesce(tarvq.text_value, coalesce(tarvq.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || tarvq.numeric_value::text, tarvq.coded_value) as "ARTRegimen",
  coalesce(labti.text_value, coalesce(labti.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || labti.numeric_value::text, labti.coded_value) as "TypeOfSampleCollection",
  coalesce(virad.text_value, coalesce(virad.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || virad.numeric_value::text, virad.coded_value) as "LastViralLoadDate",
  coalesce(virr1.text_value, coalesce(virr1.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || virr1.numeric_value::text, virr1.coded_value) as "LastViralLoadResult",
  coalesce(labno.text_value, coalesce(labno.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || labno.numeric_value::text, labno.coded_value) as "RequestingClinician",
  coalesce(conse.text_value, coalesce(conse.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || conse.numeric_value::text, conse.coded_value) as "ConsentimentoParaContacto",
  coalesce(lablo.text_value, coalesce(lablo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || lablo.numeric_value::text, lablo.coded_value) as "LocalDeColheita",
  case when coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value)), '') = '' then 'Reason Not Specified' when lower(rtrim(coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value))) = 'nao prenchido' then 'Not Specified' when lower(rtrim(coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value))) = 'suspect treatment failure' then 'Suspected treatment failure' when lower(rtrim(coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value))) = 'repiticas apos ama' then 'Repeat after breastfeeding' when lower(rtrim(coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value))) = 'rotina' then 'Routine' else coalesce(motivo.text_value, coalesce(motivo.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || motivo.numeric_value::text, motivo.coded_value) end as "ReasonForTest",
  lr.created_at as "DateTimeStamp",
  null as "Versionstamp",
  null as "LIMSDateTimeStamp",
  null as "LIMSVersionstamp",
  ax.loinc_panel_code as "LOINCPanelCode",
  lr.priority as "HL7PriorityCode",
  ax.admit_attend_time as "AdmitAttendDateTime",
  ax.collection_volume as "CollectionVolume",
  null as "RequestingFacilityNationalCode",
  null as "LIMSFacilityCode",
  null as "LIMSFacilityName",
  null as "LIMSProvinceName",
  null as "LIMSDistrictName",
  lr.requester_code as "RequestingFacilityCode",
  fmr.name as "RequestingFacilityName",
  fmr.region as "RequestingProvinceName",
  fmr.district as "RequestingDistrictName",
  null as "ReceivingFacilityCode",
  null as "ReceivingFacilityName",
  null as "ReceivingProvinceName",
  null as "ReceivingDistrictName",
  dr.performer as "TestingFacilityCode",
  fml.name as "TestingFacilityName",
  fml.region as "TestingProvinceName",
  fml.district as "TestingDistrictName",
  lr.point_of_care as "LIMSPointOfCareDesc",
  lr.request_type as "RequestTypeCode",
  ax.icd10_clinical_info as "ICD10ClinicalInfoCodes",
  lr.clinical_info as "ClinicalInfo",
  ax.hl7_specimen_source as "HL7SpecimenSourceCode",
  s.type_code as "LIMSSpecimenSourceCode",
  s.type_text as "LIMSSpecimenSourceDesc",
  ax.hl7_specimen_site as "HL7SpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_code as "LIMSSpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_desc as "LIMSSpecimenSiteDesc",
  ax.work_units as "WorkUnits",
  ax.cost_units as "CostUnits",
  dr.section_code as "HL7SectionCode",
  dr.status as "HL7ResultStatusCode",
  lr.registered_by as "RegisteredBy",
  lr.tested_by as "TestedBy",
  dr.authorised_by as "AuthorisedBy",
  ax.ordering_notes as "OrderingNotes",
  ax.encrypted_patient_id as "EncryptedPatientID",
  ax.ethnic_group as "HL7EthnicGroupCode",
  ax.deceased as "Deceased",
  ax.newborn as "Newborn",
  ax.patient_class as "HL7PatientClassCode",
  lr.requester_practitioner as "AttendingDoctor",
  ax.referring_request_id as "ReferringRequestID",
  ax.therapy as "Therapy",
  lr.analyzer_code as "LIMSAnalyzerCode",
  ax.target_time_days as "TargetTimeDays",
  ax.target_time_mins as "TargetTimeMins",
  ax.repeated as "Repeated",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tl where tl.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:link-sites' and tl.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaLink",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tp where tp.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:poc-sites' and tp.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaPoc"
from lab_requests lr
left join diagnostic_reports dr on dr.based_on_id = lr.id
left join specimens s on s.id = dr.specimen_id
left join patients p on p.id = lr.patient_id
left join attrs ax on ax.lab_request_id = lr.id
left join facility_map fmr on fmr.source_system = coalesce(lr.source_system, '') and fmr.performer_system = coalesce(lr.requester_system, '') and fmr.source_code = lr.requester_code
left join facility_map fml on fml.source_system = coalesce(dr.source_system, '') and fml.performer_system = coalesce(dr.performer_system, '') and fml.source_code = dr.performer
left join lab_results preg on preg.request_id = lr.id and preg.observation_code = 'ENCON'
left join lab_results bf on bf.request_id = lr.id and bf.observation_code = 'AMAME'
left join lab_results ft on ft.request_id = lr.id and ft.observation_code = 'VIRAP'
left join lab_results cday on cday.request_id = lr.id and cday.observation_code = 'LABDA'
left join lab_results ctime on ctime.request_id = lr.id and ctime.observation_code = 'LABHO'
left join lab_results tarvd on tarvd.request_id = lr.id and tarvd.observation_code = 'TARVD'
left join lab_results tarvp on tarvp.request_id = lr.id and tarvp.observation_code = 'TARVP'
left join lab_results tarvs on tarvs.request_id = lr.id and tarvs.observation_code = 'TARVS'
left join lab_results motivo on motivo.request_id = lr.id and motivo.observation_code = 'ESCOL'
left join lab_results tarvq on tarvq.request_id = lr.id and tarvq.observation_code = 'TARVQ'
left join lab_results labti on labti.request_id = lr.id and labti.observation_code = 'LABTI'
left join lab_results virad on virad.request_id = lr.id and virad.observation_code = 'VIRAD'
left join lab_results virr1 on virr1.request_id = lr.id and virr1.observation_code = 'VIRR1'
left join lab_results labno on labno.request_id = lr.id and labno.observation_code = 'LABNO'
left join lab_results conse on conse.request_id = lr.id and conse.observation_code = 'CONSE'
left join lab_results lablo on lablo.request_id = lr.id and lablo.observation_code = 'LABLO'
where lr.panel_code = 'VIRAL'
  and lr.authored_at >= {{param.from}}
  and lr.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
  and ({{param.facility}} = '' or lr.requester_code = {{param.facility}})
order by lr.authored_at, lr.id

    max(case when a.code = 'work-units' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as work_units,
    max(case when a.code = 'cost-units' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as cost_units,
    max(case when a.code = 'ordering-notes' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as ordering_notes,
    max(case when a.code = 'encrypted-patient-id' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as encrypted_patient_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'ethnic-group' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as ethnic_group,
    max(case when a.code = 'deceased' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as deceased,
    max(case when a.code = 'newborn' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as newborn,
    max(case when a.code = 'patient-class' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as patient_class,
    max(case when a.code = 'referring-request-id' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as referring_request_id,
    max(case when a.code = 'therapy' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as therapy,
    max(case when a.code = 'target-time-days' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as target_time_days,
    max(case when a.code = 'target-time-mins' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as target_time_mins,
    max(case when a.code = 'repeated' then coalesce(a.value_text, a.value_number::text, a.value_datetime, a.value_boolean::text) end) as repeated
  from lab_request_attributes a
  where a.system = 'urn:openldr:cs:request-attribute'
  group by a.lab_request_id
),
vl_coded as materialized (
  select upper(code) as code, display from terminology_codes where value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:vl-coded-results'
)
select
  lr.request_id as "RequestID",
  lr.obr_set_id as "OBRSetID",
  lr.panel_code as "LIMSPanelCode",
  lr.panel_desc as "LIMSPanelDesc",
  dr.issued as "HIVVL_AuthorisedDateTime",
  lr.rejection_code as "HIVVL_LIMSRejectionCode",
  lr.rejection_reason as "HIVVL_LIMSRejectionDesc",
  vlm.vd as "HIVVL_ViralLoadResult",
  vlm.vr as "HIVVL_ViralLoadCAPCTM",
  vlm.vc as "HIVVL_Low_value",
  vlm.vf as "HIVVL_Viral",
  coalesce(hivrl.text_value, coalesce(hivrl.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivrl.numeric_value::text, hivrl.coded_value) as "HIVVL_VRLogValue",
  case
    when vlc.capctm is not null and vlm.vd is null then
      case when lower(rtrim(vlc.capctm)) in ('pos', 'positive', 'invalid', 'inval', 'valid', 'indeterminado', 'negat', 'reactive', 'negative') then null when (vlc.capctm like '%<%' or vlc.capctm like '%>%') then vlc.capctm when coalesce(vlc.capctm ~ '^\s*[-+]?[$£€¥]?(\d[\d,]*(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)([eE][-+]?\d+)?\s*$', false) then vlc.capctm else 'INDETECTAVEL' end
    when vlc.capctm is null and vlm.vd is not null then case when lower(rtrim(vlm.vd)) in ('pos', 'positive', 'invalid', 'inval', 'valid', 'indeterminado', 'negat', 'reactive', 'negative') then null when (vlm.vd like '%<%' or vlm.vd like '%>%') then vlm.vd else 'INDETECTAVEL' end
    when coalesce(coalesce(vlm.vd, '') || coalesce(vlc.capctm, '') ~ '^\s*[-+]?[$£€¥]?(\d[\d,]*(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)([eE][-+]?\d+)?\s*$', false) then vlc.capctm
    when lower(rtrim(vlc.capctm)) in ('target not detected', 'not detected') or lower(rtrim(vlm.vd)) in ('target not detected', 'not detected') then 'INDETECTAVEL'
    when lower(rtrim(vlm.vd)) = lower(rtrim(vlc.capctm)) then case when lower(rtrim(vlm.vd)) in ('pos', 'positive', 'invalid', 'inval', 'valid', 'indeterminado', 'negat', 'reactive', 'negative') then null when (vlm.vd like '%<%' or vlm.vd like '%>%') then vlm.vd else 'INDETECTAVEL' end
  end as "FinalViralLoadResult",
  lr.age_years as "AgeInYears",
  lr.age_days as "AgeInDays",
  p.sex as "HL7SexCode",
  dr.effective as "SpecimenDatetime",
  lr.authored_at as "RegisteredDateTime",
  s.received_time as "ReceivedDateTime",
  dr.issued as "AuthorisedDateTime",
  lr.analysis_at as "AnalysisDateTime",
  lr.rejection_code as "LIMSRejectionCode",
  lr.rejection_reason as "LIMSRejectionDesc",
  lr.created_at as "DateTimeStamp",
  null as "Versionstamp",
  null as "LIMSDateTimeStamp",
  null as "LIMSVersionstamp",
  ax.loinc_panel_code as "LOINCPanelCode",
  lr.priority as "HL7PriorityCode",
  ax.admit_attend_time as "AdmitAttendDateTime",
  ax.collection_volume as "CollectionVolume",
  null as "RequestingFacilityNationalCode",
  null as "LIMSFacilityCode",
  null as "LIMSFacilityName",
  null as "LIMSProvinceName",
  null as "LIMSDistrictName",
  lr.requester_code as "RequestingFacilityCode",
  fmr.name as "RequestingFacilityName",
  fmr.region as "RequestingProvinceName",
  fmr.district as "RequestingDistrictName",
  null as "ReceivingFacilityCode",
  null as "ReceivingFacilityName",
  null as "ReceivingProvinceName",
  null as "ReceivingDistrictName",
  dr.performer as "TestingFacilityCode",
  fml.name as "TestingFacilityName",
  fml.region as "testingProvinceName",
  fml.district as "TestingDistrictName",
  lr.point_of_care as "LIMSPointOfCareDesc",
  lr.request_type as "RequestTypeCode",
  ax.icd10_clinical_info as "ICD10ClinicalInfoCodes",
  lr.clinical_info as "ClinicalInfo",
  ax.hl7_specimen_source as "HL7SpecimenSourceCode",
  s.type_code as "LIMSSpecimenSourceCode",
  s.type_text as "LIMSSpecimenSourceDesc",
  ax.hl7_specimen_site as "HL7SpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_code as "LIMSSpecimenSiteCode",
  ax.specimen_site_desc as "LIMSSpecimenSiteDesc",
  ax.work_units as "WorkUnits",
  ax.cost_units as "CostUnits",
  dr.section_code as "HL7SectionCode",
  dr.status as "HL7ResultStatusCode",
  lr.registered_by as "RegisteredBy",
  lr.tested_by as "TestedBy",
  dr.authorised_by as "AuthorisedBy",
  ax.ordering_notes as "OrderingNotes",
  ax.encrypted_patient_id as "EncryptedPatientID",
  ax.ethnic_group as "HL7EthnicGroupCode",
  ax.deceased as "Deceased",
  ax.newborn as "Newborn",
  ax.patient_class as "HL7PatientClassCode",
  lr.requester_practitioner as "AttendingDoctor",
  ax.referring_request_id as "ReferringRequestID",
  ax.therapy as "Therapy",
  lr.analyzer_code as "LIMSAnalyzerCode",
  ax.target_time_days as "TargetTimeDays",
  ax.target_time_mins as "TargetTimeMins",
  ax.repeated as "Repeated",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tl where tl.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:link-sites' and tl.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaLink",
  case when exists (select 1 from terminology_codes tp where tp.value_set_url = 'urn:openldr:mz:poc-sites' and tp.code = lr.requester_code) then 1 else 0 end as "IsDisaPoc"
from lab_requests lr
left join diagnostic_reports dr on dr.based_on_id = lr.id
left join specimens s on s.id = dr.specimen_id
left join patients p on p.id = lr.patient_id
left join attrs ax on ax.lab_request_id = lr.id
left join facility_map fmr on fmr.source_system = coalesce(lr.source_system, '') and fmr.performer_system = coalesce(lr.requester_system, '') and fmr.source_code = lr.requester_code
left join facility_map fml on fml.source_system = coalesce(dr.source_system, '') and fml.performer_system = coalesce(dr.performer_system, '') and fml.source_code = dr.performer
left join lab_results hivvd on hivvd.request_id = lr.id and hivvd.observation_code = 'HIVVD'
left join lab_results hivvr on hivvr.request_id = lr.id and hivvr.observation_code = 'HIVVR'
left join lab_results hivvc on hivvc.request_id = lr.id and hivvc.observation_code = 'HIVVC'
left join lab_results hivvf on hivvf.request_id = lr.id and hivvf.observation_code = 'HIVVF'
left join lab_results hivrl on hivrl.request_id = lr.id and hivrl.observation_code = 'HIVRL'
cross join lateral (select
  case when coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvd.text_value, coalesce(hivvd.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvd.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then (select vc.display from vl_coded vc where vc.code = upper(rtrim(hivvd.coded_value)) limit 1) else coalesce(hivvd.text_value, coalesce(hivvd.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvd.numeric_value::text) end as vd,
  case when coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvr.text_value, coalesce(hivvr.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvr.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then (select vc.display from vl_coded vc where vc.code = upper(rtrim(hivvr.coded_value)) limit 1) else coalesce(hivvr.text_value, coalesce(hivvr.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvr.numeric_value::text) end as vr,
  case when coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvc.text_value, coalesce(hivvc.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvc.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then (select vc.display from vl_coded vc where vc.code = upper(rtrim(hivvc.coded_value)) limit 1) else coalesce(hivvc.text_value, coalesce(hivvc.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvc.numeric_value::text) end as vc,
  case when coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvf.text_value, coalesce(hivvf.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvf.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then (select vc.display from vl_coded vc where vc.code = upper(rtrim(hivvf.coded_value)) limit 1) else coalesce(hivvf.text_value, coalesce(hivvf.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvf.numeric_value::text) end as vf
) vlm
cross join lateral (select case
  when not coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvr.text_value, coalesce(hivvr.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvr.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then vlm.vr
  when not coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvc.text_value, coalesce(hivvc.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvc.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then vlm.vc
  when not coalesce(rtrim(coalesce(hivvf.text_value, coalesce(hivvf.numeric_comparator || ' ', '') || hivvf.numeric_value::text)), '') = '' then vlm.vf
  else vlm.vr end as capctm
) vlc
where lr.panel_code = 'HIVVL'
  and lr.authored_at >= {{param.from}}
  and lr.authored_at <= ({{param.to}} || 'T23:59:59.999Z')
  and ({{param.facility}} = '' or lr.requester_code = {{param.facility}})
order by lr.authored_at, lr.id

queries.name: Mozambique facilities (v1 layout)
queries.sql:
select
  updated_at                                 as "DateTimeStamp",          -- CE's time, not v1's
  '1.1.1'                                    as "VersionStamp",           -- fixed: v1 dictionary version
  facility_code                              as "FacilityCode",
  name                                       as "Description",
  (extras::json)->>'facility_type'           as "FacilityType",
  'MZ'                                       as "CountryCode",
  (extras::json)->>'province_code'           as "ProvinceCode",
  null                                       as "RegionCode",             -- empty in v1 too
  (extras::json)->>'district_code'           as "DistrictCode",
  null                                       as "SubDistrictCode",        -- empty in v1 too
  null                                       as "LattLong",               -- empty in v1 too
  ((extras::json)->>'hf_status')::int        as "HFStatus",
  null                                       as "HealthCareID",           -- empty in v1 too
  (extras::json)->>'facility_national_code'  as "FacilityNationalCode",
  'MZ'                                       as "HealthcareCountryCode",
  'MZ' || coalesce(nullif((extras::json)->>'province_code', ''), '00')
                                             as "HealthcareProvinceCode",
  'MZ' || coalesce(nullif((extras::json)->>'province_code', ''), '00') || '00'
       || coalesce(nullif((extras::json)->>'district_code', ''), '00')
                                             as "HealthcareDistrictCode",
  'Mozambique'                               as "CountryName",
  null                                       as "CountryLattLong",        -- empty in v1 too
  region                                     as "ProvinceName",
  null                                       as "ProvinceLattLong",       -- empty in v1 too
  district                                   as "DistrictName",
  null                                       as "DistrictLattLong"        -- empty in v1 too
from facility_registry
where facility_system = 'urn:openldr:mz:facilities'
  and register_state = 'in_register'
order by facility_code
